note: Slice of Railway public GraphQL schema that the Railway import (docs/SPEC.md 9.22) reads. Project-level response fixtures still need a project token; see e2e/requests/M0-railway-import-fixtures.md.

queryFields.name: domains
queryFields.description: All domains for a service instance

queryFields.name: environments
queryFields.description: Gets all environments for a project.

queryFields.name: projectToken
queryFields.description: Get a single project token by the value in the header

queryFields.name: projects
queryFields.description: Gets all projects for a user or workspace.

queryFields.name: serviceInstance
queryFields.description: Get a service instance belonging to a service and environment

queryFields.name: tcpProxies
queryFields.description: All TCP proxies for a service instance

queryFields.name: variables
queryFields.description: All variables by pluginId or serviceId. If neither are provided, all shared variables are returned.

queryFields.name: volumeInstance
queryFields.description: Get a single volume instance by id

fields.name: clearanceDefaultForNewEnvironments
fields.description: Whether environments created from now on start with Railway Authentication protecting services that have no setting of their own. Existing environments keep their own default.

fields.name: clearanceTokens
fields.description: The project's Railway Authentication tokens that still work (not revoked, not expired), newest first.

fields.name: primaryEnvironmentId
fields.description: The id of the oldest non-ephemeral environment for this project (typically production). Used by the dashboard to render project cards without fetching the full environments connection.

fields.name: viewerRole
fields.description: Highest project-scoped role the current user holds on this project, through a direct project permission or an access group. Does not include the workspace role.

fields.name: clearanceCachingTurnedOff
fields.description: Services whose edge caching was turned off when the Railway Authentication default last turned on.

fields.name: clearanceDefault
fields.description: Whether Railway Authentication protects this environment's services that have no setting of their own.

fields.name: clearancePropagatedAt
fields.description: When the current Railway Authentication default last finished reaching every service that inherits it.

fields.name: clearanceServiceCounts
fields.description: How many of the environment's services follow its Railway Authentication default, and how many have their own on or off.

fields.name: configEtag
fields.description: Opaque snapshot token of the environment's IaC-relevant config. Echo it back as baseConfigEtag on environmentApplyChangeSet for optimistic concurrency.

fields.name: iacPartials
fields.description: IaC resource address → partial name for this environment. '*' is the whole-project owner. Used so omit=delete only applies to resources this file already owns.

fields.name: hasHiddenRegistryCredentialsFromTemplate
fields.description: Whether this service has hidden registry credentials from a template. When true, the credentials are stored in the template and used during deployment.

fields.name: isRestricted
fields.description: Whether this service has an active restriction that limits its capabilities.

fields.name: activeDeployments
fields.description: All currently active (deployed and running) deployments for this service instance

fields.name: autoInstrumentationEnabled
fields.description: Instrument the service's processes with eBPF (OBI) for supported runtimes, no code changes. Only active while tracingEnabled is true.

fields.name: clearance
fields.description: This service's own Railway Authentication setting. Null means no setting of its own: it follows the environment's default (see clearanceEffective).

fields.name: clearanceEffective
fields.description: Whether Railway Authentication protects this service's HTTP domains: its own setting, else its environment's default.

fields.name: hasEverDeployed
fields.description: Whether any deployment was ever created for this service instance, including deployments that have since been removed. Distinguishes a service that was torn down (all deployments removed) from one that has never deployed — latestDeployment and activeDeployments are null/empty for both.

fields.name: latestDeployment
fields.description: The most recent deployment for this service instance

fields.name: resolvedFileConfig
fields.description: Config read from the repo's config file, taken from the most recent deployment that actually read it. Null when no deployment has resolved a config file yet. An empty `fileManifest` is a real answer and means the repo has no config file — do not read this off the latest deployment instead, since a deployment whose snapshot never completed carries no file config at all and is not the same as a repo without one.

fields.name: tracingEnabled
fields.description: Trace requests to the service in this environment: the edge records a span per client-facing request to its domains and the next deploy provides the OpenTelemetry exporter variables.

fields.name: deploymentStopped
fields.description: Check if a deployment's instances have all stopped

types.name: EnvironmentConfig
types.description:
EnvironmentConfig is a custom scalar type that represents the serializedConfig for an environment.
JSON Schema: https://backboard.railway.com/schema/environment.schema.json
